name: Bergland
beschreibung: The Bergland holiday apartment is located in the municipality of Ellmau in the district of Kitzbühel in Tirol. The accommodation is designed for self-catering and includes a fully equipped kitchen. The amenities include several bedrooms and a bathroom. The apartment is situated in a quiet area with a view of the surrounding mountains. From Ellmau, the hiking trails and the Wilder Kaiser – Brixental ski area are easily accessible. The town offers shopping facilities and dining options. The accommodation is suitable for families and small groups.
